pages.text: Let your Preacher Servant meet with a little accident while you wear the Nameless Set—and it shall rise as a flying, undead healer. Bound Preachers still chant their healing prayers for wounded servants, only now they no longer need feet to stand on.
Of course, you can also summon a Bound Preacher directly through a ritual.
Bound Preachers heal their allies in battle.
